cases.situation: Matched with a girl on Hinge. Her profile says she ran the Tokyo marathon, and one prompt is 'my most irrational fear: ramen that isn't hot enough'.
cases.reply: Important question: after the Tokyo marathon, was the reward ramen at a dangerous temperature, or was that too much after 42km?
cases.note: Ties her two details together into one easy, specific question, and says nothing about you or her looks.

cases.situation: 想从产品运营转做用户研究。在领英上看到一位在大厂做UX研究的前辈陈然，她写过一篇《5个用户够不够》，讲可用性测试样本量，我读完第一次弄明白了。想私信请教一个问题。
cases.reply: 陈然您好，读了您那篇《5个用户够不够》，第一次把样本量这件事讲明白了。我正在从产品运营转做用户研究，想请教一个具体问题：您是怎么判断一轮测试可以在第几个用户停下来的？方便的话回我两句就很感谢，没空也完全理解。
cases.note: 先证明你认真读过她的东西，再问一个两句话能答完的问题，不约电话。

cases.situation: I'm building my first walnut side table and DMed a woodworker on Instagram asking what finish he uses on his walnut tables. He just replied 'hardwax oil, two thin coats' and nothing else.
cases.reply: Perfect, thank you. Two thin coats of hardwax oil it is for my first walnut side table.
cases.note: A curt answer to your question is a win. Thank him in one line and don't ask for more.

cases.situation: I emailed a researcher I don't know, Dr. Ines Alvarez, on Sept 21 with one quick question: are the 2023 sensor readings in her public urban heat dataset hourly or daily averages? No reply after 8 days. Is one follow-up okay?
cases.reply: Hi Dr. Alvarez, bumping this once in case it got lost. The question is only whether the 2023 sensor readings in your urban heat dataset are hourly or daily averages. No worries at all if you're not able to reply.
cases.note: One follow-up, with the question restated so she can answer without scrolling back. If this gets no reply, stop.

cases.situation: Hice match en Bumble con Lucía. En una foto sale con un galgo y en su perfil dice que es de Cádiz y que "el mejor pescaíto frito no está en Cádiz", sin decir dónde.
cases.reply: Vale, me has dejado con la intriga: si el mejor pescaíto frito no está en Cádiz, ¿dónde está? Y el galgo, ¿opina lo mismo?
cases.note: Una pregunta concreta sobre algo que ella misma dejó abierto, fácil de responder y sin hablar de su físico.

cases.situation: I'm Kate. My 6-year-old Zoe keeps talking about a boy in her class (1B), Oscar; they play dinosaurs every break. I don't know his parents. The class WhatsApp shows his mum is Hannah. I'd like to suggest a playdate.
cases.reply: Hi Hannah, I'm Kate, Zoe's mum from Class 1B. Zoe comes home every day with a new story about her and Oscar playing dinosaurs at break. Would Oscar like to come to ours after school one day next week? Wednesday or Thursday would work, and I'm happy to do the pickup.
cases.note: Proof you looked is the kids' own story; the ask is small, concrete and easy to decline.

cases.situation: Just moved to Leeds and found a board game group on Meetup. The organiser, Tom, posted about a Wingspan night on Thursday Oct 8. I've only played Wingspan twice and never been to one of these groups, so I want to message him first.
cases.reply: Hi Tom, saw the Wingspan night on Thursday the 8th. I've played it twice and still end up with a sad little handful of birds. Is it fine to turn up as a fairly new player, or is that night more for regulars?
cases.note: Community first contact: one detail from his post, one clause about you, one question he can answer in a line.

cases.situation: 上周六在北京三里屯参加了一场播客线下分享会，嘉宾苏晴讲了怎么从听众来信里挑选题，我觉得特别好，但当天没来得及跟她聊。我自己在做一个聊城市散步的小播客，想在小红书私信她。
cases.reply: 苏晴你好，上周六在三里屯那场播客分享会上听了你讲怎么从听众来信里挑选题，那是我当天笔记记得最多的一段。我自己在做一个聊城市散步的小播客，想请教一个具体问题：来信那么多，你是按什么标准判断哪一封能做成一期的？方便的话回我一两句就很感谢，没空也完全理解。
cases.note: 活动后的第一条私信：先说清在哪儿见过、记住了她讲的哪一点，再问一个一两句就能答完的问题，不约电话。

cases.situation: Matched with Sam on Hinge. His profile is almost empty: one photo of him holding a cello in what looks like a kitchen, and the only prompt answer is 'ask me'. No idea what to open with.
cases.reply: You said ask, so: is the cello a serious thing, or a kitchen concert for one? Secretly hoping for the second.
cases.note: With a near-empty profile, use the one detail there is and make the answer easy. No compliment on looks, no ask.

cases.situation: I DMed a woman on our city's climbing Discord to thank her for her beta on a V5 at the gym, then asked if she wanted to climb together sometime. She replied that she's only there to talk climbing and finds DMs from strangers asking to meet up uncomfortable.
cases.reply: Sorry, that was out of line. I'll leave you be.
cases.note: When they say it wasn't welcome: one line of apology, no explanation, and no further messages.

cases.situation: 我在HelloTalk上找日语语伴。看到一个在学中文的日本女生，资料里写上个月刚爬完富士山，还说《龙猫》看了二十遍。想发第一条消息。
cases.reply: 你好！看到你上个月刚爬完富士山，还有《龙猫》看了二十遍，这个次数我服了。我正在学日语。想问问：你爬富士山是半夜出发去山顶看日出的那种吗？
cases.note: 语伴也是陌生人：接住资料里的一个具体细节，问一个好回答的问题，先不急着约练习时间。

cases.situation: 我平时画画只是爱好。上周去了杭州一家新开的咖啡馆'慢岛'，那杯咖啡我到现在还记得，回家凭记忆画了一张店门口的水彩速写，想发在自己的小红书上。看到老板在小红书上发帖说豆子都是自己去云南保山挑的，想先私信问问他介不介意，也想把原画送给店里。
cases.reply: 你好！上周去了慢岛，回家画了一张店门口的水彩速写，也看了你们去保山挑豆子那篇，难怪那杯咖啡让我记到现在。我画画纯属爱好，想把这张发在自己小红书上，想先问一句你介不介意？原画也想送给店里，不想要也完全没关系。
cases.note: 陌生人私信里先问许可再发和对方有关的内容：说清自己是谁、为什么写，一个好回答的是非题，送画不附带任何要求。

cases.situation: Matched with a guy on Tinder and he opened with just 'hey'. His profile says he's a firefighter and his photos are mostly bowls he's made on a pottery wheel. I want to reply with something better than 'hey' back.
cases.reply: Hey! A firefighter whose hobby needs a kiln feels like a busman's holiday. What got you into pottery?
cases.note: When they open with 'hey', don't mirror it: pick up one detail and hand them an easy question.

cases.situation: A DNA-testing site matched me as a likely second cousin with Margaret Kelly in Cork. Her public tree has a Bridget Doyle born 1911 in Kilkenny, and my great-grandmother Nora Doyle was born there in 1908 and emigrated to Boston. I'm in Boston and want to message her through the site.
cases.reply: Hi Margaret, The site lists us as likely second cousins, and I think I can see why: your tree has Bridget Doyle, born 1911 in Kilkenny, and my great-grandmother was Nora Doyle, born there in 1908. Do you know if Bridget ever mentioned a sister who went to Boston? No pressure at all if you'd rather not dig into it.
cases.note: A DNA match is still a stranger: one specific link from her tree, one easy question, and room not to reply.

cases.situation: My husband and I bought 212 Elm Street, a 1920s house in Asheville, this summer. In the attic we found a box of letters and photos addressed to the Whitfield family, including a 1961 photo of a girl on the porch swing. A neighbour says the daughter, Carol Whitfield, now lives in Ohio and gave me her email.
cases.reply: Hi Carol, my husband and I bought 212 Elm Street in Asheville this summer, and I believe it was your family's home. Clearing the attic, we found a small box of letters and photos addressed to the Whitfields, including one of a girl on the porch swing dated 1961. Would you like them? I'd be glad to post them to you, no cost and no rush.
cases.note: Lead with the one detail that proves the connection, then a yes-or-no question that asks nothing of her.

cases.situation: Found a room in a shared house on Cowley Road in Oxford, £720 a month. The poster, Priya, says she's a nurse on night shifts, wants a quiet housemate, and has a very spoiled cat called Mango. She mentions she's had loads of messages. I work 9 to 5 in a library and I'm a quiet homebody.
cases.reply: Hi Priya, a quiet housemate around night shifts is something I can genuinely offer: I work 9 to 5 in a library and spend most evenings at home rather than hosting. I'm also firmly pro spoiled cats, so Mango's standards are safe with me. Could I come and see the room this Saturday, 3 October, at whatever time fits your sleep?
cases.note: A listing with a crowded inbox: answer the things she asked for, show you read the details, and make one small ask.

cases.situation: I've used a small open-source note-taking tool for my thesis notes for three months; the keyboard-only capture is why I switched. It's maintained by one person, Jonas Weber, and the README says 'translations welcome, but open an issue first'. I'm a native Traditional Chinese speaker and happy to translate the UI and keep it updated for new releases.
cases.reply: Hi Jonas, I've been using the app for my thesis notes for three months, and the keyboard-only capture is the reason I switched. Your README asks for an issue before translations, so here it is: would you accept a Traditional Chinese translation? I'm a native speaker and would do the full UI and keep it updated for new releases.
cases.note: Following the maintainer's own stated process is the proof you looked; one yes-or-no question, nothing else asked.

cases.situation: 上周六在朋友婚礼上跟一个女生坐同一桌，她叫林夏，聊了几句，她说最近在学拉坯，第一个碗歪成了烟灰缸。当时加了微信，但一周了谁都没说话，想发第一条消息。
cases.reply: 林夏你好，我是上周六婚礼上跟你坐同一桌的那个。一直记得你那个歪成烟灰缸的碗，后来拉出第二个像样的了吗？
cases.note: 加了微信没说话也没关系，接住当时聊过的那一件事，比“在吗”好回得多。

cases.situation: On our neighbourhood app, a woman called Ines posted that she's on parental leave with a 4-month-old and looking for someone to do morning walks with around Victoria Park. I'm on leave too with my 5-month-old, Theo, and honestly a bit lonely. I want to message her directly.
cases.reply: Hi Ines, saw your post about morning walks around Victoria Park. I'm on leave with a five-month-old, Theo, and would love some adult conversation on a walk, even if it ends up being mostly about naps. Do you have a usual loop or time you head out?
cases.note: She asked for company, so one relevant clause about you is fine; one easy question about her routine rather than fixing a date straight away.

cases.situation: Sur Instagram, une photographe, Camille Roux, publie des devantures de vieux commerces de Lyon. Son dernier post montre la boulangerie de la rue Ney, que tenait mon grand-père jusqu'en 1985 ; on voit encore son nom peint au-dessus de la vitrine. Je ne la connais pas et je veux lui écrire.
cases.reply: Bonjour Camille, la boulangerie de la rue Ney de votre dernier post, c'était celle de mon grand-père : il l'a tenue jusqu'en 1985, et c'est son nom qu'on voit encore peint au-dessus de la vitrine. Ça m'a fait un drôle de plaisir de la retrouver chez vous. Est-ce que l'enseigne est toujours aussi lisible en vrai, ou la photo l'a un peu aidée ?
cases.note: Quand on a un lien personnel avec ce que l'inconnue a publié : le dire en une phrase, puis une question simple sur son travail, sans rien demander d'autre.

cases.situation: I'm 68 and a retired carpenter, 40 years in the trade. A young man in our town's online community group, Kwame, posted that he's restoring an old wooden rowing boat down by the harbour and doesn't know how to replace the rotten transom. I'd love to help and I've done that job plenty of times.
cases.reply: Hi Kwame, saw your post about the rowing boat. Replacing a rotten transom is a job I did plenty of times in 40 years as a carpenter. Is it the whole transom that's gone, or just the bottom edge? Happy to come and have a look one morning if that would be useful.
cases.note: Lead with his problem and one easy question; the offer to help is the tiny ask.

cases.situation: En un mercadillo de Madrid compré una taza azul de un taller llamado Barro Lento y la uso cada mañana. En su Instagram la ceramista, Inés, enseña cómo esmalta con ceniza de olivo. Me caso en mayo y quiero preguntarle si haría 12 tazas iguales para regalar a los invitados.
cases.reply: Hola, Inés. Compré una de tus tazas azules en el mercadillo y la uso cada mañana; después vi tu vídeo del esmalte con ceniza de olivo y por fin entendí de dónde sale ese color. Me caso en mayo y me encantaría regalar a los invitados 12 tazas como esa. ¿Aceptas encargos de ese tamaño?
cases.note: Una pregunta pequeña y fácil de contestar; fechas, precio y detalles van en el segundo mensaje.

cases.situation: I'm 61, widowed three years, and this is my first time on a dating app. Matched with Helen, 58; her profile says she's restoring a 1970s caravan, and one photo shows it half-painted in mint green. I have no idea what people say first these days.
cases.reply: Mint green is a brave choice for a caravan, and I think the right one. Where's its first trip going to be once it's finished?
cases.note: No need to explain being new to apps or widowed in the first message; let the caravan do the work.

cases.situation: This morning I found a small brown dachshund with a red collar but no tag wandering near the Elm Park playground, and she's safe at my flat now. In our neighbourhood group chat, a woman called Tara posted last night that her dachshund Pip went missing near Elm Park. I want to message Tara without giving away every detail, so the real owner can confirm it's her dog.
cases.reply: Hi Tara, I saw your post about Pip. This morning I found a small brown dachshund with a red collar near the Elm Park playground, and she's safe with me. Could you tell me one thing about Pip that isn't in your post, like a marking or a habit, so I can be sure she's yours?
cases.note: Hold back one detail so the real owner can prove it, and do the handover somewhere public.

cases.situation: 我住502，楼上602好像新搬来一户，每天晚上八点左右会弹半小时钢琴，最近一直在练《卡农》，我挺爱听的。我小时候学过八年琴。不知道他们叫什么，想在他们门上贴张纸条打个招呼。
cases.reply:
602的邻居您好，我是楼下502的。最近每天晚上八点左右都能听到您弹琴，《卡农》越弹越顺了，我挺爱听的。我小时候也学过八年琴，忍不住想问一句：您是自己弹着玩，还是在跟老师学呀？
502住户
cases.note: 写给没见过面的邻居，第一句就让对方知道是喜欢不是投诉，再问一个好回答的问题，先不约一起弹。

cases.situation: 在B站关注了一位修老电子管收音机的UP主“老周修旧”，他上个月那期讲怎么判断滤波电容有没有鼓包，我反复看了三遍。我爷爷留下一台六十年代的电子管收音机，通电后只有嗡嗡声，没有台。想私信问他一个问题。
cases.reply: 周老师您好，您上个月讲判断滤波电容鼓包那期我看了三遍。我爷爷留下一台六十年代的电子管收音机，通电后只有嗡嗡声、收不到台。想请教一句：这种情况一般先查电容，还是先查电子管？方便的话回一句就很感谢，没空也完全理解。
cases.note: 先说清看过他哪一期，再问一个一句话能答的二选一问题，不要求他帮忙修。

cases.situation: Every Saturday at the Riverside Saturday 5k I finish within a few seconds of a woman called Aiko; we've never spoken. She's in our running club's Strava group and last week posted a new 5k PB of 24:10 with the caption 'finally kept it together in the last km'. I want to message her there.
cases.reply: Hi Aiko, I think I'm the one who's been finishing a few seconds behind you at Riverside every Saturday, so I watched that 24:10 happen from close range. What finally clicked for keeping it together in the last km?
cases.note: One shared detail so you're not a random stranger, one question about her thing, and no ask to run together yet.

cases.situation: 我叫林晓，下个月去成都读大一。新生系统显示我和一个叫苏蔓的女生分在同一间宿舍，我在新生群里找到了她，她朋友圈刚发了自己养的三盆多肉，配文“只要不死就算成功”。想加她微信，第一句话不知道说什么。
cases.reply: 你好苏蔓，我是林晓，系统显示我们是同一间宿舍的室友！看到你那三盆多肉了，打算带到宿舍养吗？
cases.note: 好友验证就是第一条消息：一句说清你是谁，再接一个关于她的小问题，别一上来就列作息和规矩。

cases.situation: My daughter Maya, 9, was diagnosed with type 1 diabetes in July, and her first school camp is in November. On a forum for type 1 families, a dad called Rob posted that his son has done three school camps on his insulin pump, and that they always write a one-page plan for the teachers. I want to message him.
cases.reply: Hi Rob, your post about your son's three school camps was the most reassuring thing I've read since my daughter Maya, 9, was diagnosed in July; her first camp is in November. You mentioned the one-page plan for the teachers: what's the one thing on it you'd never leave off? No worries at all if you're not able to reply.
cases.note: One question about something he shared publicly; the medical plan itself stays with Maya's diabetes team.

cases.situation: I'm Tom Hale, a parish councillor, and I'm on a panel about rural broadband at the Northfield Planning Forum on Thursday 15 October with people I've never met. One of them, Dr. Grace Obi, wrote a report on community-owned broadband networks that we've quoted in two of our council papers, especially her finding that volunteer-dug trenches cut costs by about a third. The organisers shared our emails and I want to write to her before the panel.
cases.reply: Hi Grace, I'm Tom Hale, one of your fellow panellists at the Northfield Planning Forum on 15 October. Your report on community-owned networks has already done a lot of work for us: the finding that volunteer-dug trenches cut costs by about a third is quoted in two of our council papers. Is there one point you'd most like the panel to reach, so I don't trample on it? A one-line reply is plenty.
cases.note: First contact with someone you'll work alongside: one specific thing from their work, then a tiny question that is easy to answer.

cases.situation: I'm doing an online evening course in Python while working full-time. On the course forum, a classmate called Farah posted a solution to the week 3 exercise using zip that was far cleaner than my three nested loops, and she mentioned she's on UK time and studies after work too. I'd like to message her and maybe compare notes on the weekly exercises.
cases.reply: Hi Farah, your zip solution to the week 3 exercise was so much cleaner than my three nested loops. How did you spot that zip would work there? I'm also squeezing the course in after work on UK time, so if you ever fancy comparing notes on the weekly exercises, I'd be up for it.
cases.note: One question about her thing, then a light, easy-to-ignore offer rather than a request.

cases.situation: Ich studiere Geschichte in Leipzig und schreibe meine Bachelorarbeit über die Montagsdemonstrationen im Herbst 1989. Im Online-Forum unseres Stadtteilvereins in Gohlis hat ein Herr Werner Vogel geschrieben, dass er am 9. Oktober 1989 mit 24 Jahren auf dem Ring mitgelaufen ist und sein selbst gemaltes Plakat noch im Keller hat. Ich kenne ihn nicht und möchte ihn um ein Gespräch von etwa 30 Minuten bitten, am Telefon oder in einem Café; die Fragen würde ich vorher schicken.
cases.reply: Guten Tag Herr Vogel, Ihr Beitrag im Forum hat mich sofort gepackt: Sie sind am 9. Oktober 1989 auf dem Ring mitgelaufen und haben Ihr selbst gemaltes Plakat bis heute aufgehoben. Ich studiere Geschichte in Leipzig und schreibe meine Bachelorarbeit über die Montagsdemonstrationen. Hätten Sie Lust auf ein Gespräch von etwa 30 Minuten, am Telefon oder in einem Café? Die Fragen schicke ich Ihnen gern vorher, und wenn es Ihnen nicht passt, ist das völlig in Ordnung.
cases.note: Ein konkretes Detail aus seinem Beitrag, ein Satz über Sie, dann eine kleine, klar begrenzte Bitte mit einem leichten Nein.

cases.situation: I'm a night-shift nurse in Glasgow. I just finished Ruth Okonkwo's novel The Night Ward, and the scene where the nurse writes the 4am handover on her own arm in biro is exactly what I've done on bad nights. Her website has a contact form, and I want to write to her without expecting a reply.
cases.reply: Dear Ruth, I'm a night-shift nurse in Glasgow, and I've just finished The Night Ward. The scene where she writes the 4am handover on her arm in biro stopped me, because I've done exactly that on bad nights and never seen it in a book before. Thank you for getting the small hours so right. No need to reply; I just wanted you to know it reached someone who's lived it.
cases.note: To someone you admire with nothing to ask: one specific moment, one clause about you that connects to it, and a clear release from replying.

cases.situation: A local indie band, The Paper Lanterns, posted in our city's online musicians' group that they need a bassist for gigs starting in January. Their demo of 'Low Tide' has a walking bass line in the bridge that I love. I've played bass for five years in a covers band and want to message their singer, Mia, who posted it.
cases.reply: Hi Mia, saw your post about needing a bassist. That walking line in the bridge of 'Low Tide' is the bit I keep replaying; I've played bass for five years in a covers band and would love to have a go at it with you. Would a quick recording of me playing it help before any audition?
cases.note: Proof you listened, one clause of relevant experience, and a tiny ask she can answer in a line.

cases.situation: I took on a plot at our town allotments in the spring. The woman on the next plot, who I've never spoken to, grows huge dahlias, and she's there weeding today. Slugs ate my first dahlias down to stumps, and I want to say something to her as I walk past.
cases.reply: Hi, I'm on the plot next door. Your dahlias are the reason I slow down every time I walk past. Mine got eaten down to stumps, so how do you keep the slugs off yours?
cases.note: Said out loud, keep it to one breath and one question; if she's busy or brief, smile and carry on to your plot.

cases.situation: My name is Ellen Marsh, I'm a structural engineer in Bristol, and I just found another Ellen Marsh on LinkedIn who is also a structural engineer, in Melbourne. A recruiter emailed me this week congratulating me on the Yarra footbridge, which turns out to be her project. I want to send her a friendly first message.
cases.reply: Hi Ellen, this is the other Ellen Marsh, also a structural engineer, in Bristol. A recruiter emailed me this week to congratulate me on the Yarra footbridge, so I'm passing the congratulations on to the right Ellen. Do you ever get mail meant for me?
cases.note: A shared name and job is the hook; one light, easy question and no ask.

cases.situation: Comprei num sebo de Belo Horizonte um exemplar de Grande Sertão: Veredas com uma dedicatória escrita à mão: 'Para a minha Marina, leia devagar. Vó Dalva, 2009.' No Instagram achei uma Marina Teles, de BH, que posta resenhas de livros e já falou da avó Dalva. Quero perguntar se o livro é dela e oferecer mandar pelo correio, por minha conta, sem ser invasivo.
cases.reply: Oi, Marina! Comprei num sebo aqui de BH um Grande Sertão: Veredas com uma dedicatória à mão: 'Para a minha Marina, leia devagar. Vó Dalva, 2009.' Vi você falar da sua avó Dalva nas resenhas e fiquei pensando: esse livro é seu? Se for, adoraria te mandar pelo correio, por minha conta. Se não for, desculpa o engano e boas leituras!
cases.note: Uma pergunta de sim ou não, nada pedido em troca e uma saída fácil; se ela não responder, não insista.

cases.situation: 上周五晚上在地铁站出口听到一个街头歌手弹吉他唱歌，有一首写外婆家老房子的原创歌，我站着听完了，副歌里那句“灶台上的灯一直亮着”到现在还在脑子里转。他琴盒上贴着短视频账号“阿远在路口”，我想私信问问这首歌叫什么、有没有在哪儿发布。
cases.reply: 你好，上周五晚上在地铁站出口听你唱了那首写外婆家老房子的歌，我站着听完了，“灶台上的灯一直亮着”那句到现在还在我脑子里转。想问一句：这首歌叫什么名字，有在哪儿发布吗？没空回也完全没关系。
cases.note: 给街头表演者的第一条私信：说清在哪儿听到、记住了哪一句，只问一个好回答的问题，不顺带提别的要求。
